[[File:Grafiform.png|thumb|200px|Charal's black and red grafiform robe.]]
The '''grafiform''' was a type of rare fabric, used to craft [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] which helped hide their wearer's true form. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]], self-proclaimed [[Witch-Queen]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], was known to wear robes made of grafiform at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EndorModdell">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>
